rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) names the item. Booleans take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option; _1/_2/_3 follow printed order). Schedule 1 rows map by ATC block, the printed effective-date caption and the Export/Taxable/Due column headers. The second group of Php 50.60 blocks on page 3 is left out. Page-2/3 header repeats of tinA/branchCode/registeredName are left out because each writer key can be joined once. Address line 2, Part IV date combs and tax agent cells stay blank because the layout has no key for them.
